messages.author: bd00314644d53a96
messages.subject: conditional detection models in occuMulti ()
parts:
Hi all,
I have a small question about occuMulti ().
Rota et al. (2016) said in their article that the detection of one species may also vary depending on the presence / absence, or depending on the detection / non-detection of other species.
I understand that in the original article they used a Bayesian approach, but, since occuMulti () is based on this model, I wonder if it is possible to adjust this type of conditional detection models in unmarked. I don't know if it's possible and I don't understand the syntax or if they haven't been implemented yet.

By the way, congratulations for including the multi-species model in unmarked, thanks for the effort

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: conditional detection models in occuMulti ()
parts:
Hi Gabriel,

Unfortunately you can't do this with occuMulti, at least not yet. Sorry!

Ken
